name: prism3
description: Prism3 monorepo — the token generation engine and the surfaces (theme studio, Figma plugin) that render from its shared contracts. The engine core stays buildless (run via tsx); the adapters bundle it.
// scripts: The repo's first root scripts (#789). `verify` is the gate runner — the same list ci.yml runs, in an order it declares and checks, with a per-gate PASS/FAIL table. Read verify.ts's header before changing it: the four things it exists to get right (status captured with no pipeline between, output buffered per gate, ordering declared and enforced, and a gate that did not run never printed as a pass) are each a defect that has actually shipped here.
// devDependencies: tsx is pinned EXACTLY (#3698 R4), so every `npx tsx` in CI, verify.ts and the workspace scripts runs one parser, and a new tsx reaches the repo only as a reviewed lockfile change. Before this, CI named `tsx@4` and floated within the major, and the workspace scripts' bare `npx tsx` fetched whatever was latest. Node is pinned the same way, in `.node-version`. `lint-doc-gates.ts` (`pinGaps`) fails a range here, a `.node-version` that is not an exact x.y.z, a setup-node step in ci.yml that does not read it or names its own version, and a `tsx@` spec on a CI step.
// overrides: Transitive packages held to releases at least two weeks old when they were added, because the newest of each was days old (#3408): two from @custom-elements-manifest/analyzer (S4), four from Storybook (S5). Vite's rolldown and postcss are pinned as devDependencies of apps/storybook instead, because an override did not reach the Vite nested under that workspace. Remove an entry once the newer release has aged.
